title: Pokeballs Datapack
description: Adds pokeballs to catch mobs to the game
body:
# Pokéballs Datapack

Catch mobs just like in Pokémon — directly in vanilla Minecraft!

This datapack adds **craftable Pokéballs** that allow you to capture mobs and store them inside the item.  
Carry your favorite mobs with you and release them whenever you want. Stores all nbt data of the mob inside the Pokeball so, its an exact replica. Fully multiplayer compatible with no limits!

**Make sure to also download the required resourcepack**
